steps.name: Epilogue ~ Plan B
steps.objective: A suspicious wind blows in front of [Peta] in “Orcarium.”

lines.text: (A strong whirlpool blows from somewhere and shakes the front of Orcarium Camp.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: What is this wind? It's ominous... . It seemed like it was the right thing to do in this case.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: That… .
(Peta, discovering something in the sky, tears up the magic book and chants a spell, creating magic circles around him.)
(However, the magic circles disappear in an instant due to the attack of the flying magic golem.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I guess that's why all the other wizards said they wouldn't come. Then I can't help it.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Let's run away.
(When Peta turns his back to run away, his steps stop.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Hello… How are you? Lyricaria, catch this wizard!
(As soon as Rikaria receives Noname's instructions, she grabs Peta and raises it to the sky.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Ugh, ugh… . Well, stop it!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Just answer the questions and I'll save your life.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: You want me to believe that?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Don't if you don't want to believe it.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Ah, okay. Well, what do you want to know?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: How did I survive?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: How do I know that? Your magic continued to resonate, but you died? What are you talking about? There's no way something like magic comes out when you die... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Then it's true that I'm alive now... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Okay, next!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Tell me everything you know about witches. Because I know that the witch left a mark on you.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Wasn't that over?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Hurry up and say it.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: At the Ministry of Magic, a woman who introduced herself as a witch asked if she would become a servant.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: When he refused, I told him to deliver the paper to Adventurer. That's it.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Do you remember her name, face, and name?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I don’t know… .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: All but the memory of a wizard named Zephyrus being there has disappeared.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I also lost my memory.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: If I knew anything, I would have come all this way to do something like this!!

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Actually, that's right.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Still, don’t you know anything else? Something like an experiment by the Magic Agency... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Experiment… .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I won't kill you. After all, the witch didn't kill you.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: There are many experiments, but there is one thing that comes first. Related to the soul... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: From transferring to various bodies to fusing… .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: So what is that?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Both your soul and your body... … … … … .
(Noname looks satisfied after hearing the whole story.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Now let go… . I don't want to be in such a high place... . What are you? That, that, that look... .
(Peta is surprised to discover Noname’s subtle change in expression.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Lyricaria.
(Ricaria turns towards Noname when her name is called. Then Noname smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: From now on, plan B is to go catch the witches. Sounds fun, right?
